title: Match Maker
description:
A mod that improves multiplayer convenience and adds automatic matchmaking.
Match multiplayer lobbies based on community name / language / ascension / player count / installed mods, or use quick rehosting and kick/ban features.

Doesn't affect gameplay, so you can freely play with people who don't have it installed.

https://github.com/TalkingHand/sts2-matchmaker
changeNote: Run type is now a multi-select dropdown: tick several run types and you'll be matched into a room of any of them. With 2 or more ticked you won't become host ("Allow Hosting" is unticked and locked), since there's no single run type to open a room as. When Blitz is ticked, it gets its own "Blitz Ascension Level" row, because Blitz unlocks ascension separately from the other run types.
